title: Jehoshaphat and Ahab: The War over Ramoth in Gilead
description: King Jehoshaphat joins King Ahab in a war against Aram but insists on consulting a true prophet of the Lord. The prophet Michah reveals that a lying spirit has deceived Ahab's 400 prophets into speaking lies and predicts Ahab's death, which indeed occurs at the battle of Ramoth in Gilead.
